KIMI ANTONELLI IS THE 2026 F1 WORLD CHAMPION.

20 years old. Youngest champion in F1 HISTORY.

P3 in Mexico City was all he needed.

Italy's first champion since 1953. History made. #F1Fanrecap #F1

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Antonelli broke Vettel's record by THREE YEARS.

Vettel was 23 when he became youngest champion.

Antonelli: 20 years and 68 days.

The kid from Bologna just rewrote F1 history. #F1Fanrecap #F1
